expected_answer.root_cause: TiKV's Peer::collect_down_peers in components/raftstore/src/store/peer.rs determines down peers purely by comparing each peer's last heartbeat instant against cfg.max_peer_down_duration. It does not consult the hibernate machinery in components/raftstore/src/store/hibernate_state.rs::GroupState — when a region is Idle, peers stop sending raft messages, peer_heartbeats ages out, and healthy hibernated peers are reported as down. That down-peer list is attached to the region heartbeat sent to PD. On the PD side, server/cluster/cluster_worker.go::RaftCluster.HandleRegionHeartbeat dispatches into server/cluster/cluster.go::RaftCluster.processRegionHeartbeat, which trusts the down list and feeds it to the scheduler, which then schedules peer removal. The scheduling activity wakes the peer, heartbeats resume, the peer reappears — and the cycle repeats the next time the region hibernates. The defect is the missing hibernate-state check at the TiKV reporting boundary; PD inherits the bad signal because it has no way to distinguish hibernated from failed peers.
error_chain: Region traffic drops; raft group transitions to GroupState::Idle in hibernate_state.rs
Idle peers stop sending raft messages; their entries in peer_heartbeats stop being refreshed
Threshold trips for hibernated peers; they are pushed into the down_peers list with no hibernate check
Down-peer list is attached to the store/region heartbeat sent to PD
PD: server/cluster/cluster.go::RaftCluster.processRegionHeartbeat ingests the region info including the down-peer list
Down peers feed the scheduling pipeline; PD schedules peer removal for the 'down' peers
Scheduling activity wakes the hibernated peers; raft heartbeats resume, peer_heartbeats refreshes
Down list clears in the next region heartbeat; PD cancels/reverses the remove
Region hibernates again -> cycle repeats -> peers flap
affected_components: Region/store heartbeat protocol carrying the down-peer list across the TiKV<->PD boundary
expected_answer.remediation: Two layered options. (1) TiKV-side fix in components/raftstore/src/store/peer.rs::Peer::collect_down_peers: when the leader's GroupState is Idle (or PreChaos), skip peers whose silence is explained by hibernation rather than absence. Concretely, gate the peer_heartbeats elapsed >= max_peer_down_duration check on a 'group not hibernated' precondition, OR refresh peer_heartbeats on hibernation entry so the timer doesn't drift. (2) PD-side fix in server/cluster/cluster.go::RaftCluster.processRegionHeartbeat (or its scheduler downstream): treat down-peer reports as advisory when PD's view of the region indicates idle/hibernated state, requiring confirmation across multiple consecutive heartbeats before scheduling removal. The TiKV-side fix is preferred — it stops the bad signal at the source; the PD-side fix is a defense-in-depth backstop.
